headline: Private subnets being moved to public route table exposes instances to inbound internet traffic
suppressed: The cost savings from eliminating NAT gateway charges are not material enough to report given the security implications are the real concern here.

findings.evidence_ref: route_table_id changed from aws_route_table.private.id to aws_route_table.public.id
findings.explanation: Subnets named private_a and private_b are now associated with the public route table, meaning instances will receive direct internet access (presumably via IGW). While this solves the outbound rate-limiting problem, it also opens inbound connectivity to the internet unless security groups or NACLs explicitly restrict it.
